nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run¶

CT-PET v5 pipeline master.

Entry point for the whole CT-PET v5 pipeline (stages 1-3). Dispatches each stage either locally (in-process loop over subjects) or on SGE (one array job per subject; tasks = stages with -tc 1 + done-markers). Stage 0 is not part of this master — it is orchestrated by nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.run_batch and its jid can be forwarded here via --base-hold.

Examples

Local run for one subject, only stage 2:

nvitk-pesa-fat-ctpet --batch 202602_Week4 --subjects PESA001         --stages stage2 --submit local

Submit the full chain of every subject on the cluster:

nvitk-pesa-fat-ctpet --batch 202602_Week4 --submit sge         --container /data3/BIOIT_IMAGE/Containers/gpu-pesa-fat_v2025.5.27.sif         --src-dir /path/to/nvitk/src

The --base-hold flag should be set when a stage 0 job is already in queue, so every subject’s array waits for its stage 0 sibling.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run._stage_resources(stage: str, *, device: str = 'gpu') → nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources¶

Per-stage SGE resource request.

Stage 1 always uses the GPU h_vmem config. When device is "gpu", every stage requests ngpu=SGE_NGPU (so stages 2/3 run on a GPU node too); when "cpu", every stage requests ngpu=SGE_CPU_NGPU.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run._build_python_cmd(stage: str, subject: str, lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, *, binds: nvitk.cluster.sge.SingularityBinds, backend: str, device: str, overwrite: bool, log_level: str, exclude_ureter: bool = True) → str¶

Build the python -m nvitk.pipes...stageX --batch ... --subject ... cmd.

Uses in-container paths so the worker sees the bind-mounted locations:

  • --nifti-root -> binds.data (e.g. /PESAFat/data/)

  • --results-root -> binds.output (e.g. /PESAFat/output/)

  • --model-dir -> binds.models (e.g. /models/)

  • --dicom-root is not actually used by stages 1-3, but we still set it to binds.data so BatchLayout stays consistent.

Build the ClusterPaths (container/model/data/output roots) for submitting CT-PET v5 SGE jobs from lay.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run.submit_subject_chain(subject: str, lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, stages_sel: list[str], *, container: pathlib.Path, src_dir: pathlib.Path, backend: str = 'cupy', device: str = 'gpu', model_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None, overwrite: bool = False, base_hold: str | None = None, dry_run: bool = False, log_level: str = 'INFO', emit: TextIO | None = None, exclude_ureter: bool = True) → list[str]¶

Submit one CT-PET v5 SGE array job for a single subject.

Array tasks are the selected stages in order (-tc 1 + done-markers). base_hold is applied to the whole array (e.g. the subject’s stage-0 jid).

Returns [jid] (one array job id) so batch aggregate/QC can hold on it.
